001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.domain.BoolDomain;
004
005/**
006 * An immutable expression that evaluates to a boolean.
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 */
010public interface IrBoolExpr extends IrIntExpr {
011
012    /**
013     * @return the domain of values this expression can take
014     */
015    @Override
016    public BoolDomain getDomain();
017
018    /**
019     * The negated expression is true if and only if this expression is false.
020     *
021     * @return negated expression
022     */
023    public IrBoolExpr negate();
024
025    /**
026     * Is the expression in negative form. Expressions in negated form have
027     * their class names prefixed with "IrNot...", otherwise the expression is
028     * not negative.
029     *
030     * @return true if the expression is in negative form, false otherwise
031     */
032    public boolean isNegative();
033
034    /**
035     * Dynamic dispatch on the visitor.
036     *
037     * @param <A> the parameter type
038     * @param <B> the return type
039     * @param visitor the visitor
040     * @param a the parameter
041     * @return the return value
042     */
043    public <A, B> B accept(IrBoolExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a);
044}
